summary: DataFrame egress: converts DataFrames to Python collections (tuples, dicts, named tuples, dataclasses, Pydantic models) and cross-framework formats (Pandas, PyArrow, Narwhals, Ibis) via strategy pattern with three-tier hybrid conversion. Now used by Relation terminal methods via delegation.

key_classes.name: EgressPydataFromPolars
key_classes.purpose: All Polars-native conversions including schema-aware dataclass/Pydantic conversion

key_classes.name: EgressToPythonData
key_classes.purpose: Backend-agnostic mixin delegating through Polars for Python collection conversion

key_classes.name: DataFrameEgressFactory
key_classes.purpose: Strategy factory selecting egress strategy by DataFrame type

key_functions.name: apply_native_conversions_for_egress
key_functions.purpose: Tier 1: vectorized type conversions in DataFrame before extraction

key_functions.name: apply_custom_converters_to_python_data
key_functions.purpose: Tier 3: Python-layer custom converters on extracted data

key_functions.name: _sanitize_namedtuple_fields
key_functions.purpose: Sanitize column names to valid Python identifiers for namedtuple fields

extension_points: BaseEgressDataFrame ABC for new backend strategies
lifecycle_notes: 2026-05: Relation terminal methods now delegate to egress module
2026-05: Column name sanitization added for namedtuple extraction
All DataFrame types currently route through EgressPydataFromPolars — no direct Ibis/Narwhals egress
risks: All egress routes through Polars eager — performance bottleneck for large non-Polars DataFrames

evidence.detail: Tier 1 and Tier 3 helpers including column name sanitization (updated)
